title: (1) Bowmore Seagulls / Red Band Edition 25 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky, Islay, 750ml, 43% ABV (GB)
seen_in_photos: Bowmore 25 year old Seagulls label (cream label with seagull and Islay vignette), dark navy box with seagull artwork and photo of bottle, gold screw-type capsule with red band marked Islay Malt. Back label with US Government Warning and barcode sticker. Fill is high shoulder/neck, deep dark amber spirit.
text_read: Bowmore; Product of Scotland; Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky; aged 25 years; Matured in specially selected Casks and warehoused in the Distillery; Distilled and bottled in Scotland, Morrison Bowmore Distillers Ltd (small print, partly legible); 750 ML; 43% Alc./Vol.; back: The pure water and plentiful peat used at Bowmore combine to produce this distinctive and unique Malt Whisky which has been specially selected from Casks maturing in the oldest warehouse at the Distillery, dating back to 1779; GOVERNMENT WARNING (1) According to the Surgeon General women should not drink... (2) Consumption of alcoholic beverages impairs your ability to drive...; barcode sticker on back; box: Bowmore, aged 25 years, Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky.
not_in_title: US export bottling (Government Warning back label, 750ml, applied barcode sticker, Morrison Bowmore Distillers Ltd). Title already gives Seagulls, 750ml and 43%, so this is mostly accounted for.
title_errors: none (Red Band is Webb's name for the capsule band, which matches the photo).
unreadable: Fine print of the bottler line is only partly legible; no batch or bottle number visible.
bottling_era: About 1990s to early 2000s: Morrison Bowmore ownership, 750ml, US Government Warning (post-1989), barcode, screw-style capsule, Seagulls label era.
reason: Seagulls 25 is a sought-after collector's Bowmore and the title already names it. Only small extra is the US market 750ml label, which a few collectors like. Fill good, label clean, box present, box slightly cropped in photo.
